entries.label: LinkedIn job search
entries.scope_notes: the LinkedIn runner reads the job search in your signed-in browser; the engine takes no LinkedIn action
entries.verified_note: This entry DESCRIBES today's linkedin-runner reads and adds no LinkedIn read and no action. LinkedIn's User Agreement (effective 2025-11-03) section 8.2 items 2 and 13 ban software that scrapes the Services and bots or unauthorized automated methods; ADR-037 does not rule on the existing runner (finding F2) and the owner's carve-out (2026-10-24, #774) leaves its reads as they are. LinkedIn actions are never automated.

entries.label: Indeed
entries.scope_notes: board-sweeper reads Indeed in your signed-in browser for your titles; it takes no action there. Stop it with: record.py source off indeed
entries.verified_note: The browser sweep of Indeed, as board-sweeper already runs it for a profile that holds an indeed row. Indeed's site rules (indeed.com/legal, updated 2026-09-29, section D.21) forbid automated systems including AI or Agentic AI from accessing the Site, and conditionally permit crawling as outlined in its robots.txt; whether that allowance covers an assistant reading on a job seeker's behalf is UNDETERMINED. The owner carved the sweep out of ADR-037 on 2026-10-24 (D1 on #774; the dated line is in ADR-037). The alert sender is a SEPARATE entry (indeed-alerts), so turning the sweep off never stops the alert emails. No Indeed page was opened by a maintenance agent; the terms address is the one the design's prior art already read.

entries.label: Company job-board feeds
entries.verified_note: The 0.72.0 poller as one switch: GET on the vendors' documented public job-board APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), for companies the profile already tracks. Workday (dev #775, 0.76.0) is NOT a documented API: it is read from the sitemap its tenant's robots.txt advertises plus the employer's own JobPosting JSON-LD, under the five conditions of ADR-037's 2026-10-24 line (OBSERVED; Workday documents only the JSON-LD syndication). Read for 0.72.0 (docs/design-sourcing-feeds.md section 1) and for Workday on 2026-10-24 (docs/design-workday-feed.md); not re-read for the other three vendors for 0.76.0.
